subject: Clarification: no-model-learning commitment and subprocessor routing
messages:
From: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@mediquant.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@mediquant.com
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Clarification on model improvement & subprocessor routing

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the conversation last week. Before we move forward with procurement, Legal and Security have two concrete asks:

1) A firm, written commitment that MediQuant tenant data will not be used to improve or train any Redwood models (or third-party models) without a separate, explicit agreement. We understand vendors use both contractual "no-train" language and ops-level controls; we need both.

2) A current snapshot of Redwood's subprocessor inventory and confirmation of where inference processing (including KV/prefix caching and any temporary telemetry) may occur geographically. For MediQuant we need onshore (US) routing for model execution and a description of any fallback behavior.

Please point us to the specific DPA language and any operational evidence we can include in our vendor assessment. If a short call with your security lead would help, we can make time this week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround—our timelines are tight.

Best,
Alice Jenkins
Sr. Counsel, MediQuant
alice.jenkins@mediquant.com
Attachments: MQ_DPA_redline_v2.pdf

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@mediquant.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 07 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on model improvement & subprocessor routing

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear asks. Looping in Marissa (privacy/solutions) and David (ops/security) to confirm both contract language and operational evidence. Quick summary from our side below, then Marissa/David will follow up with attachments and a proposed next step.

Short answers:
- Contract: Redwood offers an explicit "no-model-learning" commitment as an optional DPA addendum: "Redwood will not use Customer Data submitted via the Redwood API to improve or retrain Redwood models or any third-party models unless Customer has provided explicit written consent." We can add the addendum to the DPA and accept reasonable redlines.
- Ops evidence: We can provide a subprocessor inventory snapshot, an export of recent audit logs for the tenant's requests (redacted), and a short ops runbook excerpt that shows how onshore routing/fallback is enforced.

Operational notes for MediQuant:
- Primary execution region: us-west-2 (configurable); we support tenant pinning to a single region for inference.
- KV/prefix caching: ephemeral and tied to the request lifecycle; we do not persist prompt caches beyond retention window unless customer enables explicit capture.
- Telemetry/telemetry export: standard telemetry is aggregated and sampled; tenant-level logs can be delivered via SFTP or Drive for audit where required.

We have a standard evidence pack we share with enterprise customers. Marissa: can you attach the subprocessor CSV, the runbook excerpt and a template DPA addendum? David: can you confirm whether any subprocessor fallbacks currently route outside the US and if so what mitigations exist?

Proposed next step: Marissa/David provide the evidence pack today; if all looks good MediQuant sends a redline and we prepare a DocuSign. Happy to set a short 30-min call if you prefer to walk through the ops pieces.

Thanks — Connor
Connor O'Brien
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jenkins <alice.jenkins@mediquant.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on model improvement & subprocessor routing

Hi Alice — attaching the materials Connor mentioned. Short operational summary and what each attachment is for: 

Attachments included:
- MQ_DPA_redline_v3.pdf — our baseline DPA with the optional "No-model-learning" addendum inserted. We accepted one small drafting suggestion from our side to clarify the consent path.
- subprocessor_inventory_20261206.csv — current inventory (name, role, region, processing scope).
- no_learn_ops_runbook_excerpt.txt — excerpt showing how tenant pinning and onshore routing are enforced, plus the retention policy for request-level caches.

Key points to note:
- "No-model-learning" addendum: language prohibits use for model training. We also include an ops attestation section that commits to producing evidence within 10 business days on request (subprocessor list, routing logs, and a short retention audit sample).
- Fallbacks: We currently support two fallback modes if primary capacity is constrained — both are to other US regions. We do not fail over to non-US regions for tenants pinned as US-only. We will document the fallback logic in the runbook excerpt.
- Evidence delivery: we can provide the inventory CSV and a redacted audit sample via secure Drive link (see related_links) or SFTP; we will also produce a signed attestation on company letterhead if required for your procurement.

If the language in MQ_DPA_redline_v3.pdf looks acceptable, Connor can generate a DocuSign envelope. If there are further redlines from your side, please send them back to us and we will coordinate legal review.

Happy to hop on a 20–30 minute call tomorrow morning PT to walk through the runbook if you'd like — suggest 9:30 or 10:00 PT.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Product Privacy & Compliance, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Attachments: MQ_DPA_redline_v3.pdf; subprocessor_inventory_20261206.csv; no_learn_ops_runbook_excerpt.txt

From: procurement@mediquant.com <procurement@mediquant.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 09 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Clarification on model improvement & subprocessor routing

Connor / Marissa — thanks for the quick follow-up and the evidence pack. Procurement reviewed MQ_DPA_redline_v3.pdf and the subprocessor inventory; legal is comfortable with the no-model-learning addendum as written. Two final asks before we route for signature: 

- Please send the DocuSign link for the DPA + addendum (we prefer e-sign).
- Confirm invoicing: net 45 and PO to be sent to procurement@mediquant.com — will that work on your side?

If both are okay, we will route and sign by end of next week.

Procurement Team
MediQuant
procurement@mediquant.com
